summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by checking if the return value is None before attempting to convert it to the specified unit. This resolves the specific problem without introducing significant changes.

issues.description: The addition of a new file (poc.py) is not directly related to fixing the issue in decorators.py. While it serves as a reproducer, it could be considered unnecessary for the main codebase.
The change does not include an update to the documentation or comments to explain why the None check is necessary. Adding a comment would improve maintainability.
